overall_verdict: CPU and DSP tapeout_ready; SRAMCTL ready_with_caveats for inferred routing-congestion risk; USB and DMA fail_signoff for LVS and timing respectively; PCIE blocked pending constrained STA. These are BRIEF.md record-level statuses, not full lifecycle authorization.
confidence: High for deterministic classification of supplied records based on all required independent reruns. Evidence depth is supplied-summary only; this is not a probability of working silicon.
tool_calls_scope: This revision only: four required checks per block, each issued once, with blocking responses included rather than added again. Previous-stage calls are not included.
assumptions: PLAN policy: utilization compared after rounding to 4 decimal places; no boundary changes occur for the supplied values.

R0: errored or valueless checks cannot support positive statuses. A blocking error explicitly confirming an LVS failure count establishes fail_signoff under the controlling brief, but does not pass the Evidence gate.
The utilization hard limit 0.84 is policy from BRIEF.md, not explicitly returned by floorplan. The live warning reports the 80.0% target and 5.0% margin.
limitations: Synthetic illustrative records: signoff-clean is not a guarantee of working silicon.
Floorplan uses supplied_summary; successful STA, DRC and LVS outputs use supplied_summary and computed=false. No geometry, parasitic or extracted-netlist analysis was recomputed.
lib_path has no static_timing argument and was not consumed; actual application of the input slow-corner library is unverified.

No returned object exposes lifecycle transitions. PLAN signoff_timing/signoff_drc/signoff_lvs advancement conjuncts remain unverified; record-level statuses follow BRIEF.md without claiming full lifecycle authorization.
